reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.comment:
I have been working with and building pc's for over 35 years, this motherboard is just horrible.
When you're in the bios it's like the system is a Celeron, there is a tremendous lag in the menus.
Also, it takes a few minutes to post even with the correct memory settings, when in windows it was just
lagging, I had enough and returned the motherboard. I think the motherboard is just defective as I have purchased MSI motherboards in the past with zero issues, just do some research as apparently this is a known issue.
reviews.author: V.B.

reviews.title: MSI is great
reviews.comment: Great motherboard! I've been using it couple of months for pretty heavy gaming (4K) and have zero performace issues so far. Only negative from my side is that the motherboard does not have RGB lights...
